import copy
import unittest

from solution import combine_sensors


class CombineSensorsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_combines_in_input_order_without_mutation(self):
        devices = [{"name": "left"}, {"name": "right"}]
        channels = [
            [{"code": "temp", "label": "Temperature"}, {"code": "rpm", "label": "RPM"}],
            [{"code": "state", "label": ""}],
        ]
        samples = [
            {"temp": {"values": [20, 21]}, "rpm": 900},
            {"state": ["ok"]},
        ]
        before = copy.deepcopy((devices, channels, samples))
        result = combine_sensors(devices, channels, samples)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"name": "left", "channels": [
                {"code": "temp", "label": "Temperature", "value": {"values": [20, 21]}},
                {"code": "rpm", "label": "RPM", "value": 900},
            ]},
            {"name": "right", "channels": [
                {"code": "state", "label": "", "value": ["ok"]},
            ]},
        ])
        self.assertEqual((devices, channels, samples), before)
        result[0]["channels"][0]["value"]["values"].append(99)
        self.assertEqual(samples[0]["temp"]["values"], [20, 21])
        samples[1]["state"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["channels"][0]["value"], ["ok"])

    def test_repeated_input_value_is_deepcopied_separately(self):
        shared = {"nested": [[]]}
        result = combine_sensors(
            [{"name": "device"}],
            [[{"code": "a", "label": "A"}, {"code": "b", "label": "B"}]],
            [{"a": shared, "b": shared}],
        )
        first = result[0]["channels"][0]["value"]
        second = result[0]["channels"][1]["value"]
        self.assertIsNot(first, shared)
        self.assertIsNot(second, shared)
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first["nested"], second["nested"])
        self.assertIsNot(first["nested"][0], second["nested"][0])
        first["nested"][0].append(1)
        self.assertEqual(second, {"nested": [[]]})
        self.assertEqual(shared, {"nested": [[]]})

    def test_empty_inputs_and_device_without_channels(self):
        self.assertEqual(combine_sensors([], [], []), [])
        self.assertEqual(
            combine_sensors([{"name": "empty"}], [[]], [{}]),
            [{"name": "empty", "channels": []}],
        )

    def test_top_level_validation(self):
        invalid = [
            (({}, [], [])),
            (([], {}, [])),
            (([], [], {})),
            (([{"name": "a"}], [], [])),
            (([], [[]], [])),
        ]
        for arguments in invalid:
            with self.subTest(arguments=arguments):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    combine_sensors(*arguments)

    def test_invalid_devices_and_duplicate_names(self):
        invalid_devices = [
            [{}], [{"name": ""}], [{"name": 1}],
            [{"name": "a", "extra": 1}], ["device"],
        ]
        for devices in invalid_devices:
            with self.subTest(devices=devices):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    combine_sensors(devices, [[]], [{}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            combine_sensors([{"name": "a"}, {"name": "a"}], [[], []], [{}, {}])

    def test_invalid_channels(self):
        invalid_channels = [
            "bad",
            [{}],
            [{"code": "a"}],
            [{"code": "", "label": "A"}],
            [{"code": 1, "label": "A"}],
            [{"code": "a", "label": 1}],
            [{"code": "a", "label": "A", "extra": 1}],
            [{"code": "a", "label": "A"}, {"code": "a", "label": "Again"}],
        ]
        for channels in invalid_channels:
            with self.subTest(channels=channels):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    combine_sensors([{"name": "d"}], [channels], [{}])

    def test_sample_keys_must_match_exactly(self):
        channels = [[{"code": "a", "label": "A"}]]
        for samples in ([], [{"b": 1}], [{"a": 1, "b": 2}], [None]):
            with self.subTest(samples=samples):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    combine_sensors([{"name": "d"}], channels, samples)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
